ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a frog life cycle diagram, with arrows around it indicating the developmental order. Label A on the left is an adult frog; label E at the top is a cluster of eggs; label B at the upper right is a tadpole without legs; the right side and lower right show the tadpole gradually growing legs; next to label D at the lower left is a stage that already has legs, looks like a small frog, but still retains a tail. Reasoning: The question asks which label represents froglet. froglet is the transitional stage after a tadpole grows legs and before the tail has completely disappeared. In the diagram, the one that fits “has legs but still has a tail” is label D, so the answer is D.
